_comment: Copy to ~/.config/quickshell/weather.json to configure the clock drawer's weather widget.
The live shell re-reads it on save — no restart, no QML edit. Every key is optional;
anything missing or invalid falls back to the shipped default in config/Weather.qml.
THIS FILE IS THE ONLY WEATHER CONFIG IN THE REPO, AND IT IS AN EXAMPLE. A home
latitude/longitude is private infrastructure under the public-mirror rule, exactly like a
LAN IP — the real weather.json is untracked here (.gitignore) and provisioned from the
private dotfiles repo. `mise run lint:private` fails a commit that leaks one.
provider: open-meteo (default) | home-assistant | wttr.in
open-meteo    no API key, HTTPS JSON, global lat/lon coverage. Set latitude and
longitude; nothing else is required.
home-assistant  local, no external egress. Needs baseUrl + entity + tokenSecret.
wttr.in       one-call fallback; a third-party proxy, flaky under load.
label:  what the panel calls this place. Free text — and it is shown on screen, so on a
machine whose config is public keep it a city, not an address.
units:  imperial (default: °F, mph) | metric (°C, km/h)
refreshMinutes: how often to refetch. Floored at 5 — these are free APIs, not a feed.
timeoutSec: per-request budget. A hung request must not sit in `loading` forever.
forecastDays: 1..7 columns in the forecast strip.
homeAssistant.tokenSecret: THE NAME OF A SECRET, NEVER A TOKEN. It is resolved at request
time with `dotfiles-secrets --get <NAME>`, inside the same shell that makes the
request, so the value never lands in this file, in QML, or in the environment.
Must match [A-Za-z0-9_]+.
homeAssistant.entity: a weather.* entity id. Current conditions always render; a forecast
strip appears only if the integration still publishes attributes.forecast (removed
from weather entities in HA 2024.4 in favour of the weather.get_forecasts service).
Network failure is a visible state, never a blank panel: the last good reading stays on
screen marked stale, with the reason underneath and [r] to retry.
label: Home
